title: Inclusions on Web Hosting Plans: AutoSSL, Free Domain Entitlement and Malware Scanning
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — inclusions by tier**

| Inclusion | Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro | Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free automatically renewed domain-validated certificates (AutoSSL) on every hosted domain | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Free first-year domain registration entitlement | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Shortest billing term on which the free domain entitlement applies, months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Daily malware scanning included | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Definitions.**

1. *AutoSSL* — whether free automatically renewed domain-validated certificates cover every hosted domain on the plan.
2. *Free domain entitlement* — whether the plan carries a free first-year domain registration entitlement.
3. *Shortest term for the free domain* — the shortest billing term, in months, on which that entitlement applies.
4. *Daily malware scanning* — whether daily malware scanning of the site is included.

**Entitlement check (hypothetical cases).**

| Tier offers the free domain | First term of the plan | Entitlement carried |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 12, 24 or 36 months | Yes, one free first-year registration |
| Yes | 1 month | No |
| No | any term | No |
